# Vendored dependency

- pinyin-pro **3.27.0**, MIT license, https://github.com/zh-lx/pinyin-pro
- `pinyin-pro.js`: unmodified `package/dist/index.js` from the npm release archive.
- `pinyin-pro.LICENSE`: upstream license, included in the XPI.
- Registry archive integrity (SHA-512) was checked against the npm version metadata before extraction.
- Used locally in the editor for personal-name romanization. No CDN or translation API is used at runtime.

The release archive and registry metadata used for verification are kept under `research/` and are not packaged in the plugin.
